lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040se p. 7, Line 22, "If you have an unallowed rental real estate loss from a prior year that after completing Form 8582 you can include this year, include that loss on line 22." Rental B (income $4,000, not actively managed) carries a $2,000 prior-year loss; Form 8582 allows all losses ($8,000 of losses against $4,000 of passive income plus a $4,000 special allowance), so B's line 22 is ($2,000) and line 25 is ($8,000), line 26 ($4,000), line 41 ($4,000), as the project computes. The model left B's allowed prior-year loss off line 22. [dropped]
